name: QM9
description: A dataset of approximately 134,000 small organic molecules with up to nine heavy atoms, including computed geometric, energetic, and electronic properties. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Ramakrishnan, R., Dral, P. O., Rupp, M., & von Lilienfeld, O. A. (2014). Quantum chemistry structures and properties of 134 kilo molecules. Scientific Data, 1, 140022. https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2014.22
